sloka: ते द्रुमैः पर्वताग्रैश्च शिलाभिश्च प्लवङ्गमाः।अभ्यवर्षन्त समरे रावणिं पर्यवस्थिताः ।। ६.७३.३९ ।।
transliteration: te drumaiḥ parvatāgraiśca śilābhiśca plavaṅgamāḥ।abhyavarṣanta samare rāvaṇiṁ paryavasthitāḥ ।। 6.73.39 ।।

translations.english: Pierced by arrows in the battle, those Vanaras with their necks broken, giving up hopes of winning, frustrated, fell like the demons oppressed by great gods.
